baseline_note: Dated W3C publication URLs and versioned author-released papers. Source dates refer to the cited editions. School entities, permissions and inference traces are illustrative and checked by hand. No reasoner, rule engine or production authorization system was run.

claims.statement: Classes, instances, properties and class inclusion in the OWL 2 introductory model.
Description logic axiom categories and model-based entailment.
Conjunctive antecedents, consistent variable bindings and rule consequences.

RDF triple structure, RDFS subproperty entailment, RDF graph pattern queries and validation of required data values.
